description: A white paper cup sits in the middle of the surface with a toothbrush inside it, and a small toothpaste tube lies nearby. The right hand reaches forward to lift the toothbrush out of the cup while the left hand slides in to grasp the toothpaste; the left hand twists off the cap and squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles as the right hand holds the toothbrush steady, then the right hand moves the toothbrush back toward the cup.
